literal: Separation who speak hard-hearted persons if they are, impossible [is] they will bestow love that says hope.
translation: If he is hard-hearted enough to speak of separation, the hope that he will stay and show love is in vain.
modern: அவர் என்னைப் பிரிந்து செல்வதைப் பற்றிச் சொல்லும் அளவுக்குக் கடினமான மனம் கொண்டவர் என்றால், அவர் எனக்கு அன்பு காட்டுவார் என்று நம்புவது வீண்.
explanation: The heroine expresses her despair upon hearing her lover's plan to depart. She reasons that if he possesses the hard-heartedness to even speak of leaving her, he lacks true compassion. Therefore, any lingering hope that he might change his mind and show her love is completely unfounded. The word 'நசை' highlights her desperate desire, which is crushed by his cruel resolve.
